sources.title: Self-Improving Vision-Language-Action Models with Data Generation via Residual RL
sources.review_locations: arXiv v1 §3; Appendix B.2 On-the-Fly/Update frequency, C.1/C.2; official program abstract; R1 author-project release-link inspection
sources.supported_fact: Frozen VLA residual specialists → deployment-aligned hybrid rollout → SFT generalist.
sources.boundary: ICLR program과 preprint 본문 버전을 구분. 반복 base 업데이트 뒤 동일 residual 전이는 미확정. 전체 training code 미식별은 not released와 다름. Search result stpark7/pld explicitly describes a custom implementation; not official.

sources.title: Object-Centric Residual RL for Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real VLA Enhancement
sources.review_locations: arXiv v1 §3.1–3.4, §5.1–5.4, §7; official accepted list exact title/forum; R1 Appendix A.1–A.4 / A.7 and author-page code-link inspection
sources.supported_fact: Pose/proprio/base-action residual, paired teleoperation alignment, sim-real transfer and base SFT.
sources.boundary: Same residual sim-to-real is explicit; same residual across backbone families or after base SFT remains unverified. Official training code not identified on checked author pages; conference final text not verified.

sources.title: CounterAlign: Counterfactual Supervision for Vision-Language-Action Models
sources.review_locations: arXiv v1 §1, §3.1–3.3; Appendix equations 7–11, Algorithms 1–3; official CoRL accepted list
sources.supported_fact: 관측·행동 유사도 기반 negative 필터와 jointly relabeled tuple의 nnPU 학습; max-over-goal-demonstrations similarity.
sources.boundary: Shared-prefix ambiguity를 이미 명시. 필터의 coverage 민감성은 연구자 해석이며 오판/성능 저하는 관측하지 않음. 재학습/코드 실행 없음.

sources.title: VLaRL: Augmenting Vision-Language-Action Models with Simulation-Trained Latent-Conditioned Residual RL
sources.review_locations: arXiv v1 III-D / IV / VI-C limitations; staged training and demo residual targets
sources.supported_fact: Mapper is backbone-specific; residual trained per task category; VLA and mapper frozen before residual training.
sources.boundary: Preprint acceptance unverified. Task-specific residual and backbone-specific mapper do not establish a single residual checkpoint transferred across backbones.

sources.title: EXPO: Stable Reinforcement Learning with Expressive Policies
sources.review_locations: arXiv v3 §4 / Algorithm 1; official repo expo/agents/sac/expo_learner.py update/update_actor/update_edit_actor
sources.supported_fact: Base imitation and edit-policy Q updates occur together; Q selects base/edited actions.
sources.boundary: Code read, not executed. Independent base-release swap with frozen old editor not established in checked sections.

sources.title: EXPO-FT: Sample-Efficient Reinforcement Learning Finetuning for Vision-Language-Action Models
sources.review_locations: arXiv v1 §4.2–4.3 / Appendix C; pinned expo_ft.py update_actor and _update_jit; official README
sources.supported_fact: Chunk-level VLA/editor co-adaptation; code update_actor invokes actor.train_step. Frozen image encoder does not imply whole VLA frozen.
sources.boundary: CoRL acceptance separate from read arXiv version; no final-PDF equivalence claim. DROID/pi0.5 release is not a ready LIBERO/OpenVLA baseline.

sources.title: Policy Decorator: Model-Agnostic Online Refinement for Large Policy Model
sources.review_locations: Final proceedings PDF §4.1–4.3; selected Appendix B.5; frozen/transfer keyword screening
sources.supported_fact: Frozen base, bounded residual SAC and controlled exploration; BeT/DP method application.
sources.boundary: Model-agnostic method application is not evidence of the same learned weights transferred. All 36 pages not manually reviewed; code not audited.

sources.title: FIRe: Force-Informed Residual Policy for Contact-Rich Manipulation with Vision-Language-Action Models
sources.review_locations: Author project Abstract / Methodology / RQ5 / Implementation settings
sources.supported_fact: Author explicitly claims same residual policy across GR00T, pi0.5 and OpenVLA; force/proprio/relative-pose contact controller.
sources.boundary: RA-L submission only. Paper/code coming soon; linked PDF returns 404; no checkpoint-level training provenance. Counts as a public collision claim, not independently verified transfer.

sources.title: Accelerating Residual Reinforcement Learning With Uncertainty Estimation
sources.review_locations: v2 IV-B / V-D; official assymetric_sac.py critic_loss_fn and actor complete-action path
sources.supported_fact: Combined-action critic is established; official implementation scores residual plus base action.
sources.boundary: IEEE page JS challenge. Author acceptance and publisher-deposited Crossref metadata identify RA-L 11(1), January 2026; acceptance reported 2025. Code not executed; TD3 contract is not SAC-paper reproduction.

sources.title: Overcoming Exploration in Reinforcement Learning with Demonstrations
sources.review_locations: Author PDF Q-Filter subsection, Eq.8; publisher-deposited Crossref metadata
sources.supported_fact: Q-filter applies imitation only when teacher action is valued above actor action.
sources.boundary: Foundation outside 2024–2026 trend count; publisher page JS limited. Original algorithm/code not reproduced.

sources.title: What Does It Take For A Generalist Robot Policy To Adapt Using Minimal Data?
sources.review_locations: v3 Oct21 §4/6; Appendix E/I.4/J; v1 was discovery only
sources.supported_fact: Few-demonstration VLA adaptation uses value-based residual learning; representation/data balance and filtered imitation are investigated; DICE shares core principles.
sources.boundary: Latest title differs from v1 Adaptation of Generalist Robot Policies with Minimal Data. Workshop listing is not main acceptance. No training repo identified on checked project page; paper not fully reviewed.

sources.title: From Prior to Pro: Efficient Skill Mastery via Distribution Contractive RL Finetuning
sources.review_locations: v2 §4; README and model/rl/distill_residual_rl_img.py selected filter/loss paths
sources.supported_fact: DICE-RL freezes prior, learns chunk residuals with selective regularization and value selection; code has Q/Monte-Carlo filtering.
sources.boundary: Our deterministic TD3/Q-filter controls are not full DICE reproduction. Public Robomimic/flow implementation is not a ready OpenVLA/LIBERO adapter.

candidates.name: Residual policy adaptation across independent VLA updates
unknowns: exact A-SHA parent of B despite author SFT-to-RL model-card lineage
native load/controller compatibility and A residual trainability
whether a frozen residual or scalar gain already suffices
base-action versus visitation shift and obsolete correction
sample-efficiency advantage beyond warm-start, imitation and EXPO-like selection
Q-filter/two-reference composition has weak independent algorithmic novelty; native multi-update evidence needed

candidates.name: Coverage-aware counterfactual reward learning
unknowns: coverage-dependent error beyond existing filter and nnPU
native offline RL effect beyond simple balancing
candidates.analytic_observation: For fixed features/query, enlarging reference support cannot decrease max similarity; membership in a bounded threshold interval need not be invariant. Duplicate repetition alone need not change the max.

candidates.name: Independent validation for model-based VLA RL
unknowns: benefit under matched real interaction budget

r1_review.question: Can a residual trained with A be adapted cheaply to an independently supplied B while retaining B's improvements and useful old corrections?
not_novel_by_itself: Q selection of base versus corrected action
scalar gain, warm start or multi-base training

coverage.review_boundary: Selected primary text/appendix and public source inspection; PLD/Object-Centric final conference text unavailable; no absence-of-all-prior-work claim

code_reviews.finding: update_actor -> actor.train_step; _update_jit invokes base update; current release also includes Real-Time EXPO-FT; not a ready LIBERO adapter

input_action_candidate.initial_decode_proposal: same deterministic decode for both; original train temperature is not evaluation setting

limitations: No weights downloaded or checksummed locally
No native load, step rate, memory, CUDA/EGL validation
HF code-file equality does not verify loader implementation compatibility
One pair cannot establish general transfer; A may be weak or B near ceiling

analysis.keep_old_composite: c_A=a_A+r_A(o,a_A); r_keep=c_A-a_B => a_B+r_keep=c_A in consistent additive coordinates. This preserves old composite, not B gains.
analysis.composition_boundary: Same clipping/filter/queue required; quaternion composition requires group inverse; charge both A/B queries.
minimal_arms: warm-start residual on B vs fresh residual on B at matched new interaction/update budget
strong_followups: EXPO-style base/edited Q selection or co-adaptation at matched cost
analysis.scientific_prediction: Selective adaptation may remove obsolete A corrections while keeping corrections still useful with B; effect/estimator unproven.
fairness: Hold robot/task/action units/controller and decoding fixed
Freeze residual observation encoder for first study
Record actor versus critic/replay transfer explicitly
No privileged state in observable-policy claim
Matched new interactions, resets, base queries, compute and old-residual sunk cost separately
analysis.success_metric: Episode success over matched initial-state distribution; delta J(B+r)-J(B) and J(A+r)-J(A); adaptation learning curves/cost; no zero-shot success inference from action distances

next.scope: One small comparison contract and adaptation hypothesis; no repeated literature census; before runtime implementation
next.fallback: If simple alternatives exhaust useful gap, prioritize VRL-2; lack of GPU alone is not scientific rejection

task.name: STUDY_SCENE1_pick_up_the_book_and_place_it_in_the_back_compartment_of_the_caddy
task.instruction: pick up the book and place it in the back compartment of the caddy
task.selection_reason: One-object placement; selected before native results, not performance-based
task.warmup_action_boundary: already environment command; do not repeat VLA gripper conversion
task.reward: 1 at first native success, otherwise 0; terminal at success/deadline; collector budget cuts censored

observation.vla_input: Single RGB 224 with original processor/crop and fixed instruction; no proprio; same deterministic discrete decode and dtype on A/B
observation.residual_encoder: Frozen A vision_backbone + projector; mean visual patches, use_film=false; never replaced with B encoder
observation.feature_dimension: d = loaded projected-feature width, assert native output against config
observation.proprio: two 8-D EEF position/axis-angle/gripper observations; normalize by fixed A q01/q99
observation.first_history: duplicate current frame/proprio; last action equals warmup dummy env command
observation.actor_input: x plus normalized current base chunk [8,7]
observation.critic_input: x plus composite environment command chunk [8,7]
observation.limitation: Fixed instruction and two observation frames: no language generalization or full Markov sufficiency claim

action.scale_units: normalized base-action quantile coordinates, not metres/radians
action.composition: C_v: add alpha*u to first 6 normalized coordinates; clip to [-1,1]; original unnormalizer; original gripper binarize/invert; final controller input clip
action.zero_residual_check: C_v(x,0) agrees with native base environment commands within dtype-appropriate tolerance fixed in P0
action.terminal_prefix: store full commanded chunk, actual k<=8 and rewards; unused terminal suffix has no environmental effect; no future-dependent action feature mask

algorithm.learner: TD3 with value-filtered two-reference actor regularization; original experimental combination of established components, not claimed novel algorithm
algorithm.noise_coordinate: u before residual scaling, clamp u [-1,1]
algorithm.A_initialization: zero final actor layer; 100 decision collection warmup; no actor/critic updates until 100 transitions

A_bootstrap.teacher_and_anchor: none; u_A teacher exists only after this training
A_bootstrap.replay: A-stage actual transitions only; no old/new mixture before B stage
A_bootstrap.boundary: The actor_objective/critic_target fields below describe B adaptation, not A bootstrap

algorithm.teacher: frozen copy u_A queried with B action chunk, not A action; no full A-policy query needed by P

masks.old: both target critics strictly rank c_old above c_0 and c_theta
masks.base: both target critics strictly rank c_0 above c_old and c_theta

algorithm.uncertainty_boundary: Twin-critic agreement is not calibrated confidence or safety/regression guarantee

B_transfer.actor: warm start from A except F

algorithm.B_critic_initialization: New twins seed202; common B/B+rA probe and D_A; 500 critic-only updates under B-alone continuation, then identical weights and reset optimizer states copied to all arms
algorithm.actor_target_initialization: copy each arm's initial actor; no stale A target/optimizer

replay.old_data: keep actual commanded action/reward/k/next obs/termination; no invented transition under B+old residual
replay.B_actions_on_old_states: deterministic B requery/cache with both old current/next images; charge compute

algorithm.learnability_boundary: Sparse reward, fixed feature/alpha and small budget may fail to bootstrap; failure does not refute residual transfer

arms.anchor: zero if both target Q(base)>Q(current), coefficient0.1
old if both target Q(old)>Q(current), coefficient0.1

gain.selection: highest calibration success; tie smaller gain

IL-S.data: D_A + common probe + W online trajectories, identical to W available raw data

IL-R.objective: composite 6-D command MSE weighted by exp((return_to_go-batch_max)/0.1), mean-normalized

auxiliary_controls.data_cost: charge W collection to each imitation control; matched data does not imply same closed-loop experience in other RL arms
auxiliary_controls.keep_old_composite: analytical recentering identical to static A+rA; no redundant extra rollout arm

split.interpretation: residual-stage reset holdout within one task; no base-training unseen/OOD claim
split.evaluation_units: 10 distinct held-out initial states, not frames/chunks

P0.scope: IO only; not full rollout or residual learning

B_common_probe.policy_mixture: choose B or B+rA per episode with probability0.5, seed303; record realized counts

budget.note: Whole future study upper bounds, not next-turn auto-execution allowance. P0 only is the next scope. Stop at the first decision/step/reset cap; updates may be fewer. Compare common achieved decision checkpoints; never duplicate or impute unachieved 500/1000 checkpoints. Equal caps do not imply equal realized resource use; unfinished budgets and censored episodes remain explicit.

paired win/loss/tie versus B and W/F/Z/G
metrics.scope: one task, one pair, one training seed, 10 evaluation states; no broad generalization, statistical confirmation or sample-complexity claim
metrics.subgroups: B-success versus B-failure subsets descriptive only; data-defined subgroups are not independent confirmatory tests
